narr: Showers and thunderstorms formed in the vicinity of a stationary front and produced isolated heavy rain resulting in one flash flooding report.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Marble Creek sent over a foot of water over the roadway at the 6700 block of Colton-Bluff Springs Rd. in southern Austin.
lsr: LOW WATER CROSSING AT 6700 COLTON-BLUFF SPRINGS ROAD CLOSED WITH OVER A FOOT OF WATER ON THE ROADWAY.
